{{Quote|Completed my autopsy on Researcher Orgglo. Gamma 19 didn't even leave marrow behind. I'm placing the creature in suspended animation until we reach Sleheyron. Management needs to start hiring staff with common sense. The line on the floor says "do not cross" for a reason.|Vipp|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Vipp''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] science officer serving aboard the ''[[Theoretika]]'', a [[research vessel]] operated by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. One of the ship's primary projects in its final years of activity was a bioengineered [[jurgoran]] specimen labeled [[Specimen Gamma 19]]. During her autopsy of [[Orgglo]]'s remains, Vipp determined that the specimen had consumed Orgglo down to even the marrow, prompting Vipp to place the creature in suspended animation. Around a century before [[3639 BBY]], the ''Theoretika'' was damaged during its [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump and ended up in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], causing a major hull breach on the port side of Deck 5, and its crew slowly turned on each other. The crew died out in a variety of accidents, though most of the crew was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the ship's [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] reclassified the ''Theoretika''{{'s}} remaining food stores as an infestation and destroyed them with its pesticide protocols.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Science Officer Vipp appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in hologram during the "''Theoretika''" mission.
